blocks.directed: A body without animating consciousness isn’t going to do much.

blocks.text: And similarly, a mantra isn’t fully understood merely by its visible letters or audible syllables.
blocks.directed: And similarly, a mantra isn’t fully understood merely by its visible letters or audible syllables.

blocks.text: It must be enlivened by the pure powers of awareness.
blocks.directed: It must be enlivened by the pure powers of awareness.

blocks.text: Those powers are like the life-breath entering a body.
blocks.directed: Those powers are like the life-breath entering a body.

blocks.text: When the mantra is awakened through them, it becomes:
blocks.directed: [short pause] When the mantra is awakened through them, it becomes:

blocks.text: And such an enlivened mantra can bestow both:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And such an enlivened mantra can bestow both:

blocks.text: The efficacy of mantra, within this teaching, isn’t simply a property of mechanically repeating a sequence of sounds.
blocks.directed: The efficacy of mantra, within this teaching, isn’t simply a property of mechanically repeating a sequence of sounds.

blocks.text: It’s intimately connected with the consciousness and powers those sounds express.
blocks.directed: It’s intimately connected with the consciousness and powers those sounds express.

blocks.text: And now — after all this business with mirrors, vowels, consonants, divine emissions and cosmic goddesses — we’re finally ready to return to the original question.
blocks.directed: And now — after all this business with mirrors, vowels, consonants, divine emissions and cosmic goddesses — we’re finally ready to return to the original question.

blocks.text: How does any of this liberate you?
blocks.directed: How does any of this liberate you?

blocks.text: Forget the alphabet for a moment.
blocks.directed: Forget the alphabet for a moment.

blocks.text: Because now you’ve seen the structure.
blocks.directed: Because now you’ve seen the structure.

blocks.text: All of it has been understood as the differentiated manifestation of one supreme consciousness.
blocks.directed: All of it has been understood as the differentiated manifestation of one supreme consciousness.

blocks.text: And what’s required now isn’t another complicated conceptual performance.
blocks.directed: And what’s required now isn’t another complicated conceptual performance.

blocks.text: I am the very ground in which all these reflections appear and come to rest.
blocks.directed: I am the very ground in which all these reflections appear and come to rest.

blocks.text: Not the limited identity I’ve constructed around myself.
blocks.directed: Not the limited identity I’ve constructed around myself.

blocks.text: The very reality within which all these distinctions arise.
blocks.directed: The very reality within which all these distinctions arise.

blocks.text: And when this recognition is complete, the person is liberated while living.
blocks.directed: And when this recognition is complete, the person is liberated while living.

blocks.text: Not because the universe has disappeared.
blocks.directed: Not because the universe has disappeared.

blocks.text: Not because the body has evaporated.
blocks.directed: Not because the body has evaporated.

blocks.text: Not because the person has become incapable of seeing distinctions.
blocks.directed: Not because the person has become incapable of seeing distinctions.

blocks.text: But because those distinctions are no longer apprehended as realities separate from the supreme consciousness.
blocks.directed: But because those distinctions are no longer apprehended as realities separate from the supreme consciousness.

blocks.text: They are recognised as its own manifestations.
blocks.directed: They are recognised as its own manifestations.

blocks.text: And just as I told you in the previous chapter, at this level there is no necessity for being constrained by mantra repetition or similar techniques.
blocks.directed: And just as I told you in the previous chapter, at this level there is no necessity for being constrained by mantra repetition or similar techniques.

blocks.text: Because the recognition itself is immediate.
blocks.directed: Because the recognition itself is immediate.

blocks.text: The entire universe, with all its categories, beings, and worlds, rests in that one supreme consciousness.
blocks.directed: The entire universe, with all its categories, beings, and worlds, rests in that one supreme consciousness.

blocks.text: Which brings us to my closing verse.
blocks.directed: Which brings us to my closing verse.

blocks.text:
अन्तर्विभाति सकलं जगदात्मनीहयद्वद्विचित्ररचना मुकुरान्तराले।बोधः परं निजविमर्शरसानुवृत्त्याविश्वं परामृशति नो मुकुरस्तथा तु॥
MY SLANG RENDERING
blocks.directed:
[slowly] अन्तर्विभाति सकलं जगदात्मनीहयद्वद्विचित्ररचना मुकुरान्तराले।बोधः परं निजविमर्शरसानुवृत्त्याविश्वं परामृशति नो मुकुरस्तथा तु॥
MY SLANG RENDERING

blocks.text: The entire universe shines within the Self.
blocks.directed: The entire universe shines within the Self.

blocks.text: Just as a fantastically intricate world might appear within a mirror.
blocks.directed: Just as a fantastically intricate world might appear within a mirror.

blocks.text: The mirror doesn’t know a bloody thing about what it’s reflecting.
blocks.directed: The mirror doesn’t know a bloody thing about what it’s reflecting.

blocks.text: Consciousness apprehends the entire universe through the very delight of its own self-awareness.
blocks.directed: Consciousness apprehends the entire universe through the very delight of its own self-awareness.

blocks.text: And that is something no ordinary mirror can ever do.
blocks.directed: And that is something no ordinary mirror can ever do.

blocks.text: So the universe isn’t simply an image appearing in a dead reflective surface.
blocks.directed: So the universe isn’t simply an image appearing in a dead reflective surface.

blocks.text: It is an appearance within a living, self-aware, utterly free consciousness.
blocks.directed: It is an appearance within a living, self-aware, utterly free consciousness.

blocks.text: And the fundamental reality of that consciousness?
blocks.directed: And the fundamental reality of that consciousness?

blocks.text: The method of Śakti: how thought itself can become the instrument of liberation.
